children: MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $348.9M, up 22.8% from $284.2M a year earlier, while reporting a loss from continuing operations of $1.6M and diluted EPS of $(0.09) for the year — results disclosed in its 10-K filing.
Revenue was $348.9M, compared with $284.2M in the prior year; YoY change 22.8%.
Net income was $(1.6)M, compared with $10.7M in the prior year; YoY change (114.9%).
Diluted EPS was $(0.09), compared with $0.65 in the prior year; YoY change (113.8%).
Consolidated net sales rose 22.8% in FY2026 driven by higher volumes, pricing and mix, and reduced dealer incentives.

The company completed the Marine Products merger on May 15, 2026, adding the Chaparral and Robalo brands and creating a new Recreation & Sport Fishing segment; that segment generated $33.3M in initial net sales.
Performance & Wake sales increased 12.6% on higher unit volumes and average selling prices.
Gross margin improved by about 290 basis points due to cost controls and favorable mix, partially offset by a $2.6M inventory step-up and Leisure impairments.
FY2026 operating results were affected by elevated costs related to the transaction, ERP implementation, and integration amortization.
